description: 搜索 itch.io 游戏和项目，返回标题、作者和链接；支持确认后的空结果。Search games and projects.

steps.fn: () => { const query='{{query|js}}', limit=Number('{{limit|js}}'); if(!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<1||limit>20)throw new Error('limit must be an integer from 1 to 20'); const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.game_cell_data')].slice(0,limit).map(c=>({title:c.querySelector('.game_title > a.title')?.textContent.trim(),url:c.querySelector('.game_title > a.title')?.href,author:c.querySelector('.game_author')?.textContent.trim()})); const empty=rows.length===0 && document.body.innerText.includes('No results found'); return {query,rows,count:rows.length,empty,matched:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('q')===query && document.querySelector('.search_header h2')?.textContent===`Search results for '${query}'` && (empty || (rows.length>0 && rows.every(r=>r.title&&r.url&&r.author)))}; }
